entries.clue: Little bunch of sweet-smelling flowers, once carried against street stenches.
Lower leg of a chicken, the piece children always ask for
Great old sailing ships, oddly naming a magic circle of sixty-odd trees.
Partner to the bubble in a fry-up of yesterday's greens and potato
Dry wood note smelling much like freshly sharpened pencils.
Trail a wearer leaves behind in a room, named from the wake of a boat
Harsh and burnt-smelling, as smoke off a bonfire of damp green wood
Small thin sausage, wrapped in rashers beside the Christmas bird
Aberdeen ___, the breed named on menus to promise a premium joint of beef
Dark fluid in a drawing pen; the Wood's first pictures are made of it.
Slow outward breath that carries a whole mood without a single word
Creature conjured out of a misread note beginning GON OUT
